name: synthesia-hero
title: Synthesia Hero
description: Inspired by the synthesia.io website design — an AI video platform hero with an oversized two-tone headline whose accent words carry a periwinkle-to-indigo gradient, a G2 social-proof pill, and a large gradient card holding a product video. One video is split into five equal segments and each tab owns a slice: playback drives the active tab automatically, a white indicator pill springs between labels, and a faint fill inside it tracks progress through the current segment. Segment length is derived from the video's real duration, so swapping the source keeps the slices even. Includes a sticky navbar, staggered entrance choreography, and a mute toggle.
